core_obligations: Choose the presentation square with U, V schemes and surjective etale vertical arrows (proof lines 4688-4697).
Show that U -> V is locally of finite type and that V is locally Noetherian (proof lines 4697-4699).
Apply the scheme case to conclude that U is locally Noetherian (proof lines 4699-4701).
Conclude that X is locally Noetherian by definition (proof lines 4701-4702).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if f : X -> Y is locally of finite type over a scheme S and Y is locally Noetherian, then X is locally Noetherian (source lines 4680-4686). The proof takes a commutative square with U, V schemes and surjective etale vertical arrows: local finite typeness of f makes U -> V locally of finite type, local Noetherianness of Y makes V locally Noetherian, and the scheme statement that a locally finite type morphism over a locally Noetherian base has locally Noetherian source gives that U is locally Noetherian, which by definition means X is locally Noetherian.
